prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Interior Linear T8 4ft 2-lamp to LED Tube
prescriptive_measures.incentive_formula: ((64W - 36W) x 1 fixture) / 1000 x $1,000/kW = $28.00 per fixture; project cap: $20,000 or 50% cost
prescriptive_measures.notes: kW demand reduction = (64W-36W)/1000 = 0.028 kW; incentive = 0.028 kW x $1,000 = $28.00 per fixture. Licensed electrical contractor required.
